item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea tomorrow. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening in the following couple of days, the weather over southeastern China will improve gradually. It will be very hot early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to affect the central part of the South China Sea early next week.
